# Parano1d v1.0.0 Mainnet

The transparent proof-native Layer 1. Ordered by proof-of-work. State validated
from genesis in O(1). Provable end-to-end post-quantum soundness from genesis
at NIST PQC Category 1.

> “The present must prove the past. Now it does.”
>
> — Ignotus Nemo

**Public network launch · 13 August 2026 · 08:00 UTC**

This release starts the canonical public network from a new genesis

## Packages

Choose the GUI package for the Parano1d wallet, its built-in full node and
mining from the desktop application. It does not require a separate daemon or
terminal.

Core archives are intended for headless node operation, command-line use and
external mining. They contain the full node, command-line wallet client and
external miner.

Native packages are attached for Linux x86-64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86-64,
macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel.

## Release verification

Release assets are attached below. Verify every archive and installer against
the attached `SHA256SUMS` file before running it.
